claims.claim: L5 records for morphine show rapid intestinal absorption and Caco-2 transport well above low-permeability markers, while buprenorphine and samidorphan show high Caco-2 permeability; these close morphinan/opioid analogs support an adequate intestinal absorption component for the query morphinan.
